sloka: तैर्निमित्तैश्च दृष्टार्थैः कारणैश्च महागुणैः ।ऋषिवाक्यैश्च सिद्धार्थैरभवं हृष्टमानसः ।। ५.५८.१६२ ।।।।
transliteration: tairnimittaiśca dṛṣṭārthaiḥ kāraṇaiśca mahāguṇaiḥ ।ṛṣivākyaiśca siddhārthairabhavaṁ hṛṣṭamānasaḥ ।। 5.58.162 ।।।।

translations.english: "For these two auspicious signs and the highly propitious words uttered by the sages I felt glad at heart.
